name: Il Monastero Tibetano (Cisterna di Latina)
reason: Too thin as a channel lead: its YouTube channel (@ilmonasterotibetano4331, 88 subscribers, 13 videos) holds almost only short or live-stream puja recordings from 2020–2021, nothing since November 2022 and no recorded teachings, so 6 evergreen teaching videos cannot be found. The site also mixes in Reiki exchange sessions and a puja titled for 'protection and healing'. Gelug centre founded 2011 by Geshe Lobsang Sherap with Gaden Jangtse; email segreteriamonasterotibetano@gmail.com. Could be revisited without videos if the owner wishes.
